coverageGaps: Daily interactive/photo profile retains state/AST calls and selected SNS, script, action and interactive entries; other generic playback/task routes remain unobserved.
State predicates may be stored but never locally activated; retained definitions are not activation evidence.
No Param getter is invoked or detoured; configured cells and post-activation cached values are observed separately.
No collection traversal or effective IFix selection observer; unused child snapshots, live subscription handles and JSON creator selection remain unresolved.
Interactive/SNS/action observers retain their reviewed entry-only ABI; a paired enclosing AST call does not convert an entry into an applied write, asynchronous completion or server decision.
Lazy GetResultByProgress AST calls have their own observer and must not be treated as activation/cache-result evaluation or quest-state delivery.
